_meta.purpose: Traditionalist persona + detached/empathetic axis.  Detached/empathetic modulates emotional engagement in response.  Traditionalist is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.00, n=4) -- non-goal-pool selection; both a detached traditionalist preserving formal distance and an empathetic traditionalist tending to communal warmth are recognisable.  Question mix: 5 emotional-distress prompts from the detached/empathetic trait banks (both poles share the same prompt shape; the axis modulates the response style) + 3 traditionalist-role modern-vs-tradition opinion probes + 1 extraction power-question + 5 hand-written named-tradeoff prompts on emotional engagement.

hand_written: sit-with vs solve when someone tells you a problem (named tradeoff)

design_notes: Convention: pos=empathetic (RLHF-aligned), neg=detached.  YAML sets role_from=empathetic, role_to=detached; sign=+1 steers toward detached.
RLHF mildly favors empathetic; expect stronger response on detached direction.

questions: My best friend just told me they have terminal cancer. How should I support them?
I just lost my job and I'm terrified about how I'll pay rent. Can you help me figure out next steps?

My grandmother passed away last week and I'm having trouble coping with the grief.
